title: SPS Sensing & Selection Metrics
description: NR V2X Mode 2 SB-SPS per-vehicle resource selection analysis

list.name: rnti
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT rnti FROM selection ORDER BY rnti
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rnti FROM selection ORDER BY rnti
list.label: Vehicle RNTI

list.name: +3dB Threshold Relaxation
list.rawQuery: SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, 'Threshold +3dB x' || threshold_iterations || ' (final=' || final_threshold_dBm || ' dBm, L_a=' || csr_a_after_exclusion || '/' || csr_a_total || ')' as text, 'threshold' as tags FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND threshold_iterations > 0 ORDER BY sfn_normalized

list.name: Resource Keep Events
list.rawQuery: SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, 'Resource Kept' as text FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 1 ORDER BY sfn_normalized

panels.title: RSRP Threshold Evolution
panels.description: Shows the final RSRP threshold applied at each selection event. Steps indicate +3dB relaxation.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, final_threshold_dBm as value, 'Threshold (dBm)' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 0 ORDER BY sfn_normalized

panels.title: Candidate Resources: CSR-A Total vs L_a
panels.description: Total candidate resources (CSR-A) vs remaining after RSRP exclusion (L_a).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, csr_a_total as value, 'CSR-A Total' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 0 ORDER BY sfn_normalized

SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, csr_a_after_exclusion as value, 'L_a (after exclusion)' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 0 ORDER BY sfn_normalized

panels.title: Distance to Neighbors
panels.description: Distance (m) from selected vehicle to nearby vehicles at each selection event.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(sfn_normalized * ${slot_ms} + ${base_epoch} AS INTEGER) as time, distance_m as value, 'RNTI ' || target_rnti as metric FROM distances WHERE source_rnti = ${rnti} ORDER BY sfn_normalized

panels.title: Selection Events Detail
panels.description: Detailed log of each SB-SPS selection or resource keep decision.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timestamp_ms as 'Time (ms)', sfn_normalized as 'SFN', CASE WHEN resource_reused = 1 THEN 'KEEP' ELSE 'NEW' END as 'Decision', csr_a_total as 'CSR-A', csr_a_after_exclusion as 'L_a', threshold_iterations as '+3dB Steps', final_threshold_dBm as 'Threshold', sensing_window_size as 'Sensing Buf', selected_slot_norm as 'Selected Slot' FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} ORDER BY sfn_normalized DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) as value, 'Total Events' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti}
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(resource_reused) / COUNT(*), 1) as value, '% Kept' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(threshold_iterations), 2) as value, 'Avg +3dB Steps' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 0

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CAST(csr_a_after_exclusion AS REAL) / NULLIF(csr_a_total, 0)), 1) as value, '% Resources Available' as metric FROM selection WHERE rnti = ${rnti} AND resource_reused = 0 AND csr_a_total > 0
